summary: Verified nginx routing fix for /flyer-mockups/* static PNG assets. All 9 backend routing tests pass (100%). The four PNGs (founding.png=184922B, download.png=225876B, founding-thumb.png=151760B, download-thumb.png=191612B) are now served by the Next.js website (:3001) with Content-Type image/png and correct PNG magic bytes, no longer falling through to the Expo web app's 'Unmatched Route' 404. Regression checks confirm /meet, /register-interest, /admin still return HTML 200 from the website, and / still serves the Expo app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: nginx path-multiplexer at /app/config/nginx/app-proxy.conf routes specific prefixes to the Next.js website upstream (:3001) and everything else to Expo (:3002). /flyer-mockups/ was added to the route table. Tests in /app/backend/tests/test_flyer_mockup_routing.py cover both the fix and regression of /meet, /register-interest, /admin, and /.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: nginx location block for /flyer-mockups/ was missing from /app/config/nginx/app-proxy.conf, so requests fell through the default location that proxies to the Expo web app (:3002). Expo Router returned its catch-all 'Unmatched Route' 404 HTML for any unknown path. Fix: added `location ^~ /flyer-mockups/ { proxy_pass http://website_upstream; }` block, copied config to /etc/nginx/nginx.conf, validated with `nginx -t`, and restarted nginx-app-proxy supervisor service. Verification: curl -I now returns Content-Type: image/png with correct Content-Length matching on-disk file size, and body starts with PNG magic bytes (89 50 4E 47). No 'Unmatched Route' HTML anywhere in the response body.
